program: Wingless cross-domain training-only support diagnosis under fixed data budget
question: Does the supported R5 training-only support diagnostic transfer prospectively to unseen source domains: can it flag class-support risk before target-domain bytes or labels are opened, and do the unseen targets actually exercise the preregistered zero-support classes?
hypothesis: Run three leave-one-domain-out arms over the exact external source manifest. In every arm, exclude the target domain entirely from representation/relation/class construction and training-only diagnosis. Use an identical 15,819-byte training budget derived deterministically and proportionally from the two non-target sources, preserve the exact R5 512-motif/8x64-class/repaired-relation mechanics, compute and freeze the zero-training-margin class set, then open exactly 1,454 target-domain bytes. Supported requires at least two of three arms to prospectively flag a nonempty zero-support set and then observe at least one target query whose repaired top-1 lands in that frozen unsupported set, with zero preflight target-byte/label use and no capacity or authority change. This is diagnostic transfer only; no cognitive modification is selected or retained.

portfolio_context.role: advisory-only; objective is future-dataset learning efficiency, not self-modification

prior_evidence.limitation: R5 was retrospective on the originating external dataset and does not establish transfer to unseen future data.

external_authority.execution_host_policy: GitHub-hosted compute only; host distinct from LINKDEADKB

fixed_budget.training_allocation_rule: For the two non-target sources, allocate the 15,819-byte budget proportionally to their exact source lengths using floor for the first canonical source and the remainder for the second; take exact source prefixes only.
fixed_budget.target_rule: Open no target bytes before preflight freeze; afterward evaluate exactly the first 1,454 bytes of the target source.
fixed_budget.capacity: exact R5 fixed 512 motifs and eight fixed 64-motif classes; no growth
fixed_budget.compute: same repaired-relation bridge and depth-3 runtime cap as R5

prospective_protocol.preflight_signal: per-class count of training depth-3 repaired-margin samples
prospective_protocol.risk_rule: flag arm iff at least one fixed class has zero training-margin samples
prospective_protocol.decision_freeze: serialize target domain, training identities/budgets, zero-support class set and risk flag before target bytes are opened
prospective_protocol.validation: after freeze, count target depth-3 queries whose repaired top-1 belongs to a frozen zero-support class; target truth bytes may be scored only after the decision is frozen
prospective_protocol.label: self-improvement precursor / transfer diagnostic only

classification_rules.supported: Validity passes; at least two of three leave-one-domain-out arms freeze a training-only support-risk diagnosis and the unseen target later exercises at least one of those frozen unsupported classes.
classification_rules.mixed: Validity passes and at least one arm transfers prospectively, but fewer than two arms confirm.
classification_rules.negative: Validity passes but no arm's training-only support-risk diagnosis is confirmed on its unseen target.
classification_rules.invalid: Any parent, authority, source, fixed-budget, target-isolation, class identity, decision-ordering, determinism, capacity, provenance, or qualification criterion fails.

no_post_result_tuning_rule: Do not alter source identities, 15,819-byte training budget, 1,454-byte target budget, proportional allocation rule, target arms, representation/relation/class mechanics, risk rule, metrics, thresholds, classification, or authority after primary output.

successor_if_supported.intent: compare no-change versus a frozen bounded candidate mechanism on a preregistered disjoint future dataset under identical data/compute/capacity budgets; retain nothing without transfer advantage

successor_if_mixed_or_negative.intent: attribute why the training-only diagnostic transfers to some unseen domains but not others before any modification-selection experiment
